adiponectin, AdipoR1, AdipoR2 and PPARα are the most promising therapeutic targets for obesity-linked insulin resistance, metabolic syndrome and cardiovascular disease.

adiponectin, AdipoRs and their signaling pathways are the major regulators in the integrated regulation and treatment of obesity-linked diseases, and therefore, adiponectin agonists and AdipoR activators may be a promising therapeutic approach for obesity-linked diseases.

adiponectin has been shown to be a key regulator of metabolic and cardiovascular disease.
